name: Object relocation
definition: Pick up one or more objects and move, place, or discard them at a specified location, arranging or stacking them if requested, without changing their state.

name: Clean and place
definition: Wash, rinse, clean, or wet an object and then leave, place, or discard it at a specified location.

name: Cool and place
definition: Cool, chill, or freeze an object in the refrigerator or freezer and then leave, place, or discard it at a specified location.

name: Heat and place
definition: Heat, warm, or cook an object and then leave, place, or discard it at a specified location.

name: Fill with water and place
definition: Fill a container with water and then leave it or place it at a specified location.

name: Lamp-object interaction
definition: Pick up or hold an object while turning on a lamp or light, or hold, place, or examine an object under or near a lamp's light.
